Validate feature membership and existing standalone execution/accounting/delivery semantics. Plans belong to the feature: one active approved plan and one pending replacement. Draft edits, submission and rejection preserve active authority and eligible work; no plan-version management UI. Shared human/agent task and issue priority edits plus bulk task ordering commit revisioned history. Screens expose Blocked by/Blocks and editable same-project cross-feature/standalone links; reject invalid/self/duplicate/cyclic changes without partial writes. Human/agent tasks.set_feature and optional feature at issue creation share authoritative membership. Link authorizes delivery without revised-plan approval; clear pauses until manual resume. Filter unsatisfied dependencies before priority and manual rank; use atomic queue revisions for edits/claims. Prove concurrent dependency edits cannot form a project-wide cycle and high-priority blocked tasks cannot bypass prerequisites. No automatic preemption on priority changes. Keep-working yields a fully dependency-blocked root only after quiescence, allowing prerequisite roots to run while preserving one active root, coordinator lineage and explicit holds; valid task-level interleaving across features must not deadlock. Membership changes update root/feature queue eligibility atomically and fence stale claims; an owned task never gains a second execution. Relinking cannot clear an unlink pause.

Feature-plan approval atomically promotes the exact pending draft with active scope/acceptance and history. Stale approval/edit races preserve the original plan; rejection leaves it approved. Approval never clears a pause.

Adding a blocker fences affected future dispatch; safe interruption/reconciliation preserves in-flight effects. Completion/removal wakes eligible dependents without clearing independent controls.
